title: Hypercontractivity from the last-coordinate parts
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $q\ge2$, and $f$ a real-valued function on $\{-1,1\}^{n+1}$. If the hypercontractive inequality with noise parameter $1/\sqrt{q-1}$ holds for both the average and the half-difference of the two restrictions of $f$ obtained by fixing the last coordinate to $1$ and $-1$, then it holds for $f$ itself.
hypotheses_covered: The stated hypercontractive inequality holds for the average of the two last-coordinate restrictions
The stated hypercontractive inequality holds for their half-difference
